auth_plugin.description: Authentication method. Use 'password' for username+password login; avoid 'none' in production.

servers.description: List of database servers to show in the login interface.

hostname.description: Host or IP address of the database server.

port.description: Port number. Auto-defaults to typical port per driver if omitted.

username.description: Optional default username (leave blank to prompt user).

password.description: Optional default password. For security, avoid hard-coding passwords in production.

persistent.description: Use persistent connections to this server? May improve performance but can exhaust connection pools.

https_only.description: Enforce HTTPS. Should be true in production to prevent credential interception.

theme.description: Theme name or path to custom CSS. Default includes 'default', 'blueberry', 'fresh', etc.

plugins.description: List of enabled plugins. Examples: 'sqllog' (log queries to DB), 'login-ssl' (client cert auth), 'dump-json'.

default_dbname.description: Default database used if user selects server but no DB is provided.

default_server_name.description: Name of the default server from $SERVERS to preselect.

default_username.description: Default username if omitted in login.

default_password.description: Default password (⚠️ avoid hard-coding in production).

time_limit.description: Maximum script execution time in seconds (e.g., for large imports).

persistent_connections.description: Enable persistent DB connections globally? Use with care to avoid exhausting DB connection limits.

import_max_size_mb.description: Maximum allowed file size (in MB) for SQL/file uploads in the import interface.

editor_indent.description: Number of spaces to use for SQL editor indentation.

editor_tabs.description: Use tab characters instead of spaces in the SQL editor?
